PLAN "Perimenopause-Aware Strength & Bone Loading"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
GOAL primary strength
name "Build and maintain bone density through progressive compound loading"
END GOAL
GOAL secondary muscle
name "Preserve lean mass and metabolic resilience during hormonal transition"
END GOAL
GOAL tertiary recovery
name "Manage thermoregulation and heat intolerance with structured cooling protocols"
END GOAL

PHASES
PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Tolerance Mapping" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 60m "Lower body compound focus"
WARMUP
walking 5m
leg_swings 10 each leg
hip_circles 10 each direction
bodyweight squat 8 reps
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
leg_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
walking 3m
quad_stretch 45 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 45 seconds
hamstring_stretch 45 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper body horizontal pull & press"
WARMUP
rowing 5m
arm_circles 15 each direction
scapular_retraction 10 reps
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
walking 3m
chest_stretch 45 seconds
lat_stretch 45 seconds
shoulder_stretch 45 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday training 50m "Vertical loading & accessory"
WARMUP
cycling 5m
shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
neck_roll 10 each direction
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
overhead_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds

COOLDOWN
